info.name: GeckoLib Reborn Plugin (custom controllers)
info.description: Adds GeckoLib support for NeoForge 1.21.1 (GeckoLib 4.9.2) and NeoForge 26.1.2 (GeckoLib 5.5.2) on MCreator 2026.2. Patched build: animated entities can define extra named animation controllers, optionally additive (real GeckoLib 5 additiveAnimations blending), and the play/stop/get animation blocks target a controller by name.
info.author: CBJaxx (patched)
